day_shape: 62 items: Qatar-brokered IAEA-for-sanctions-relief proposal awaits Tehran reply while Iran reportedly rejects it, White House rules out pre-midterm strikes but Patriot battery moves from Texas, fresh OFAC SDN action, Khamenei letter to students, Iran inflation 88.7%.

threads.label: Qatar nuclear-sanctions proposal and diplomacy
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Qatar is awaiting an Iranian response to a proposal allowing IAEA inspections in exchange for sanctions relief, while Iran International reported a senior Iranian official called the Qatari ideas unacceptable. Defa Press and IRIB quoted FM Araghchi saying Iran will continue contact with intermediaries to give the seven-day plan a chance.

threads.label: US posture on renewed strikes
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported the White House said Iran is in "very bad condition" and ruled out further strikes before the US midterms, while a separate report said the US is moving a Patriot battery from Texas to the Middle East. Iran International reported Netanyahu, holding on after Tuesday's election, raised the prospect of renewed military action against Iran alongside the US.

threads.label: Iran economy under pressure
threads.summary: Iran International reported year-on-year inflation reached 88.7% in the month to 22 October per the Statistical Center of Iran, and cited economists weighing a contraction comparable to the Great Depression. The Jerusalem Post reported up to 1.4 million Iranians could leave the labour market by year-end; Iran's acting oil minister Bovard faces scrutiny over missing revenues.

threads.label: Khamenei letter to students
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a letter from Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei responding to letters from students, urging them to equip themselves with knowledge and faith and increase Iran's strength. IRIB carried follow-up material from the Basij student council welcoming the response.

threads.label: Hezbollah statement on Iran and Lebanon
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press carried a statement from Hezbollah Secretary-General Sheikh Naim Qassem saying Iranians thwarted US and Israeli objectives to overthrow the Islamic system and that Iran made halting aggression against Lebanon a top priority. The Jerusalem Post reported Qassem called the Israeli election results a "failure".

threads.label: IDF Gaza and West Bank operations
threads.summary: The IDF announced the elimination of three Hamas commanders in Gaza, including Nukhba Force members who participated in the 7 October attack, and a separate strike killing Ahmed Muhammad Ahmed Baraka. The IDF also reported a counterterrorism operation in Judea and Samaria following the Hebron shooting, with six suspects apprehended including a Hamas affiliate.

threads.label: US sanctions and nuclear-weapon messaging
threads.summary: OFAC published a Federal Register notice adding persons and vessels to the SDN List, while the Jerusalem Post cited Washington Institute experts urging expanded sanctions and counterterrorism cooperation. Iran International reported the IRGC-linked Fars news agency promoted street-interview calls for Iran to build an atomic bomb.

events.title_en: Pezeshkian: Were the children of Minab and Lamerd terrorists?
events.summary_en: Pezeshkian: Were the children of Minab and Lamerd terrorists? The schoolchildren of Minab, the children of Lamerd - were these terrorists? It is shameful! We will never forget the memory of these dear ones. The head of one of the think tanks in America said we apologise to you for such a crime against Iran. We are ashamed to have such a president. They were truly astounded and did not know what to say and what to do. I understand how difficult it is; of course saying that we understand differs greatly from understanding through actual burning and real suffering. Those who have lost a child or a companion better know how difficult it is to bear these circumstances.

events.title_en: Julani whitewashes his terrorist record in Iraq
events.summary_en: Julani whitewashes his terrorist record in Iraq. The former terrorist and interim governor of Syria claimed that his main motivation in 2003 for being in Iraq was to counter the American military invasion and occupation and stemmed from patriotism and zeal for the Iraqi people. The interim governor of Syria emphasised the necessity of people-to-people and social relations between Iraq and Syria taking precedence over political relations and recalled that these two countries share historical ties and common destiny and should strengthen their mutual cooperation further. He added that he was arrested in 2005 and played no role in the sectarian sedition events of 2006; because due to cutting off news during his detention he was unaware of developments

His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, the Supreme Leader of the Revolution, in response to letters from groups of students across the country which they have sent to His Eminence in recent months, described the resolve, will and sense of responsibility of these young people for building the future as the thread of connection of 'covenant-companionship' between the leadership and youth, and emphasised equipping oneself with the weapon of knowledge, faith, self-refinement and the redoubled effort to increase Iran's strength and power. events.title: ⭕️ COUNTERTERRORISM OPERATION IN JUDEA & SAMARIA: Following last Friday’s shooting attack in Hebron, in which Staff Sergeant Ron Yonatan Roytman and Sergeant Yuval Shai Svilem fell, security forces continue operating to thwart terrorism in the area. During the operations, 6 suspects were apprehended, including an individual affiliated with Hamas. The suspects were allegedly involved in terrorist activities, including planning and facilitating terrorist attacks. Additionally, forces confiscated weapons including an M16 rifle, knives, a vest & a replica gun. The IDF will continue operating to thwart terrorism and maintain security throughout Judea and Samaria.

events.title: The final voter turnout in Israel's national elections among IDF soldiers reached 79.9%, the military says. The IDF says this is an increase of 6.2% compared to the previous elections in 2022. Conscripts, career soldiers, and reservists began voting a week ago at over 890 polling stations deployed to military bases across the country and beyond Israel's borders, including at army posts in the Gaza Strip, Lebanon, and Syria.
events.summary:

events.title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
events.summary: The U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is publishing the names of one or more persons and vessels that have been placed on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN List) based on OFAC's determination that one or more applicable legal criteria were satisfied. All property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction of these persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from engaging in transactions with them. The vessels placed on the SDN List have been identified as property in which a blocked person has an interest.
